reuse.why: Creates a new getScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts beside the already exported getScheduledAmount (same missing/number/range dispatch, used by the client) instead of changing and reusing that helper.

duplication.why: Removes four inline midpoint copies but adds a second amount-resolution helper that duplicates getScheduledAmount, and leaves the schedule-template midpoint copy in place.

placement.why: The rule is put in shared/schedules.ts, the right layer for schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the amount call sites and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Two near-identically named helpers now encode different rules (worst-case vs midpoint), so the UI, budget templates and server disagree and a maintainer must know which to call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts adds getScheduleAmount instead of using/changing the existing getScheduledAmount; getScheduledAmount (desktop-client) and schedule-template.ts keep the midpoint rule.

disguised_duplication.where: getScheduleAmount is getScheduledAmount's null/number/range dispatch under an almost identical name, without the inverse option.

one_place.where: The new rule lives in getScheduleAmount for server paths and the preview, while getScheduledAmount (client lists, balances, schedule editor) and schedule-template.ts still apply the midpoint.
